item.ptxt: Check the following items before replacing the discharge headlight bulb. If there is a malfunction, repair or replace parts, then inspect the discharge headlight bulb again.
Check that the high voltage socket of the headlight light control computer assembly and the discharge headlight bulb are connected properly.
Check that the high voltage socket of the headlight light control computer assembly and the connector of the discharge headlight bulb are not damaged.

atten4.ptxt: Even if the discharge headlight bulb illuminates normally temporarily, it is not necessarily normal and the problem may be difficult to reproduce, so perform all of the following inspection steps in order.

s3.ptxt: Before performing the inspection, keep the discharge headlight bulb off for 10 minutes or more so that it is completely cooled.

atten4.ptxt: To determine the cause of the discharge headlight bulb not illuminating, the inspection must be performed starting with the discharge headlight bulb in a cooled state.

s3.ptxt: Illuminate the discharge headlight bulb for 25 minutes or more, and check that it illuminates normally at the start and end of illumination.

item.ptxt: To stabilize the tube voltage of the discharge headlight bulb, keep it illuminated for 25 minutes or more.
A discharge headlight bulb at the end of its service life has an increased tube voltage, so it may be turned off by the fail-safe function of the headlight light control computer assembly.

s3.ptxt: After inspection 1, repeatedly turn the discharge headlight bulb off for 15 seconds and on for 15 seconds (5 times each), and check that it illuminates normally.

atten4.ptxt: This inspection is performed to check the startability at hot start.

s3.ptxt: After inspection 2, turn off the discharge headlight bulb and leave it off for 3 minutes.
After leaving it off for 3 minutes, illuminate the discharge headlight bulb for 3 minutes, and check that it illuminates normally at the start and end of illumination.

item.ptxt: As a characteristic of discharge headlight bulbs, the starting voltage is highest 3 minutes after the light is turned off, which may be an unfavorable condition for starting.
This inspection is performed to check the startability at hot start.

specitem.ptxt: The discharge headlight bulb illuminates normally without flickering in all steps.

s3.ptxt: Remove the discharge headlight bulb and visually check the condition of the arc tube.

specitem.ptxt: The inside of the arc tube should not be swollen or cloudy white. However, brownish dullness inside the arc tube is normal.

entry.ptxt: Discharge headlight bulb at end of service life
